title: auritus job purge --yes does not skip its own confirmation prompt
description:
'auritus job purge --yes' still prompts interactively with typer.confirm()
even though --yes's own help text says "Skip the dry-run confirmation and
actually delete." In cli/src/auritus/commands/job.py's purge_jobs, --yes
only skips the *dry-run preview* step; it does not skip the subsequent
typer.confirm(f"Delete {matched} jobs?") call at job.py:158.

This makes --yes useless for non-interactive/scripted use (e.g. looping
over sites and statuses to wipe all jobs), which is exactly the scenario
the flag's own help text advertises. Found while running the full-wipe
step of production cost-tracking testing; worked around with `echo "y" |
auritus job purge ...` for this session.

Fix: when --yes is passed, skip the typer.confirm() call entirely (it's
the same flag; there's no need for a second confirmation).
